title: 2ManyPlaceholders
description: A collection of placeholders to make server data managing easier
body:
A plugin to make server data managing easier with placeholders

## This plugin obviously needs PlaceholderAPI.
## Current Placeholders (Will Be Updated, Feel free to give me ideas on discord, "kane44hd")

1. %cauthon_player_name%: Prints out Player Name
2. %cauthon_uuid%: Prints out Player UUID
3. %cauthon_health%: Prints out Player Health
4. %cauthon_hunger%: Prints out Player Hunger
5. %cauthon_experience%: Prints out Player Experience (Level/Total)
6. %cauthon_playtime_seconds%: Prints out Player Playtime as seconds
7. %cauthon_playtime_minutes%: Prints out Player Playtime as minutes
8. %cauthon_playtime_hours%: Prints out Player Time as hours
9. %cauthon_player_ping%: Prints out Player Ping
10. %cauthon_player_ip%: Prints out Player IP Address
11. %cauthon_server_ip%: Prints out Server IP Address
12. %cauthon_server_tps%: Prints out Server Tick Per Second (TPS)
13. %cauthon_server_difficulty%: Prints out Server Difficulty
14. %cauthon_server_entity_count%: Prints out Currently Loaded Entity Count
